source_entries.source-stripe-kakao-pay-accept-payment: - [[source-stripe-kakao-pay-accept-payment]] — The full 2026-05-08 guide describes one-time Kakao Pay (`kakao_pay`) acceptance through Checkout or a Direct API PaymentIntent, with a redirect to Stripe's local processor partner for authentication and authorization. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.) November capture is variant navigation; detailed behavior remains dated to earlier full captures.
source_entries.source-stripe-kakao-pay-set-up-future-pa: - [[source-stripe-kakao-pay-set-up-future-payments]] — The full guide captured on 2026-05-08 describes saving Kakao Pay (`kakao_pay`) for later payments through Checkout setup mode or a Direct API SetupIntent, and a separate PaymentIntent route for saving during a payment. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.) November capture is variant navigation; detailed behavior remains dated to earlier full captures.
source_entries.source-stripe-klarna: - [[source-stripe-klarna]] — Stripe's Klarna payment-method overview covers customer payment options, geographic and amount conditions, cross-border presentment, refunds, Connect, and country filtering. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.)
source_entries.source-stripe-klarna-accept-payment: - [[source-stripe-klarna-accept-payment]] — May 6, 2026 Klarna acceptance guide for Stripe, with Checkout, Elements, Direct API, iOS, Android, and React Native variants. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.) November capture is variant navigation; detailed behavior remains dated to earlier full captures.
source_entries.source-stripe-klarna-best-practices: - [[source-stripe-klarna-best-practices]] — Stripe's May and November 2026 Klarna best-practices guides recommend early Express Checkout Element placement, product-page Payment Method Messaging, relevant cart line items, and optional shipping and billing data. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.)
source_entries.source-stripe-klarna-compliance: - [[source-stripe-klarna-compliance]] — This Stripe page records Klarna network eligibility, marketing, termination and merchant duties. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.)
source_entries.source-stripe-klarna-disputes: - [[source-stripe-klarna-disputes]] — Stripe guide to Klarna payment disputes: a customer files a complaint or return request in the Klarna app; most cases pass through an inquiry before a chargeback, while some reach chargeback directly. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.)
source_entries.source-stripe-klarna-set-up-future-payme: - [[source-stripe-klarna-set-up-future-payments]] — The 2026-05-06 full Stripe guide describes saving a Klarna PaymentMethod for later subscription renewals or on-demand purchases. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.) November capture is variant navigation; detailed behavior remains dated to earlier full captures.
source_entries.source-stripe-klarna-supplementary-data: - [[source-stripe-klarna-supplementary-data]] — The May 6 and November 7, 2026 captures describe the same Klarna-only public preview for sending industry-specific supplementary purchase data on a PaymentIntent. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.)
source_entries.source-stripe-konbini: - [[source-stripe-konbini]] — Konbini is a single-use, Japan-domestic JPY cash voucher method for Japan-based businesses and customers. (S03 reviewed update, 2026-11-15; capture-dated qualifications apply.)
